estimate.damage_summary: An atmospheric overvoltage event damaged the television and speaker system connected to the building’s mains. A technician subsequently documented the surge failure and checked the wiring.
estimate.policy_notes: The damaged electronics are covered under the lightning-overvoltage peril, subject to the EUR 5,000 gross aggregate appliance sub-limit and the pre-loss-standard replacement basis. Because the description establishes that no overvoltage protective device was used, indemnity for the appliances is halved. Diagnostic/reporting and call-out charges are not repair costs on the information provided; VAT is reimbursed only if actually incurred and not recoverable as input tax.

lines.invoice_text: Surge-damaged home electronics (speaker system and TV set)
lines.rationale: Both appliances are described as physically damaged by the covered overvoltage event, and two items is plausible. Allow only standard-grade equivalents of the pre-loss equipment; the absent protective device halves the otherwise payable amount.

lines.invoice_text: Diagnostic surge-failure report and technician call-out
lines.rationale: The visit relates to the reported event, but confirming failure, producing a diagnostic report and checking wiring are not identified as physical repair work; the call-out exception does not make a standalone diagnostic visit indemnifiable. If treated as valid, one report/attendance unit is plausible, not three.
